dialogues.speaker: Wizard Moneybags
dialogues.text: Undisciplined, inelegant, unoriginal, uninspired... and completely uncoordinated.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hey, what'cha complaining about? Oh, lemme guess, all your teammates we defeated?

dialogues.speaker: Wizard Moneybags
dialogues.text: I'm talking about your fighting style.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Huh? Have you been hit in the head by a Specter, or something? This ain't some circus show, pal! You wanna know what my style is? Uncheckable strength, unwreckable will, and undefeatable beetles, that's what! I can give you a demonstration — if you dare.

dialogues.speaker: Wizard Moneybags
dialogues.text: Ugh, you bring back some bad memories... I do not deal well with loud and obnoxious types like you.

dialogues.speaker: Wizard Moneybags
dialogues.text: #Ah, but this {M#blond fellow}{F#blonde lady} looks like easy pickings... Alright, I'll challenge {M#him}{F#her}!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hahahaha! Hey, compadre, did you hear what this joker just said? He thinks you're an easy win! So uh, how about you show him a little Arataki Gang hospitality?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon doesn't get it... These people haven't researched their opponents at all! All they're doing by coming one at a time is contributing to our winning streak.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Grandmaster Hanakado's team members are a real mixed bag! They're no match for us three when it comes to strategy!

choices.text: Oh nooo~! Please don't bully me...
